snippet.title: Wild Tactics - Official Playtest Announcement Trailer| The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Check out the Playtest Announcement Trailer for Wild Tactics, a turn-based strategy game developed by The Wild Gentleman. Players will lead a team on a top-secret crime-fighting mission to save the Wilderness requiring strategic moves, skills, and more. The first Playtest for Wild Tactics is launching in July 2025 for PC (Steam).
